conflict.both_deleted: The item is deleted on this device and on the server. Either choice ends the conflict, and the item stays deleted.
conflict.deleted_local: You deleted this item on this device.
conflict.deleted_server: This item was deleted on the server.
conflict.dialog.accept_deletion_body: Your version on this device is dropped for good. The item stays deleted.
conflict.dialog.delete_mine_body: The server's version of this item is dropped for good, and the item is deleted on every device.
conflict.dialog.keep_mine_body: The server's version of this item is dropped for good, on every device. Your version replaces it.
conflict.dialog.keep_mine_damaged_body: The server's newest version of this item cannot be opened. Your last good version on this device is written to the server as the newest one.
conflict.dialog.keep_mine_quarantined_bo: The server says this item is deleted, but the deletion could not be checked. Your version on this device is written to the server, and the item comes back.
conflict.dialog.keep_server_version_body: Your deletion on this device is dropped. The item stays as it is on the server.
conflict.dialog.keep_theirs_body: Your version on this device is dropped for good. The server's version stays.
conflict.dialog.restore_body: The server's deletion is dropped. The item comes back on every device, with your version.
conflict.heading: This item was changed in two places
conflict.help.accept_deletion: The item stays deleted. Your changes on this device are dropped.
conflict.help.delete_both_mine: The item stays deleted. Nothing is written.
conflict.help.delete_both_theirs: The item stays deleted. Your deletion on this device is dropped.
conflict.help.delete_mine: The item is deleted on every device.
conflict.help.keep_mine: Your version replaces the server's version on every device.
conflict.help.keep_server_version: Your deletion is dropped, and the item stays as it is on the server.
conflict.help.keep_theirs: Your changes on this device are dropped.
conflict.help.restore: The item comes back on every device, with your version.
conflict.intro: This item was changed on this device and somewhere else before the two could be brought together. Choose the version to keep. Nothing is merged, and the version you do not keep is dropped.
conflict.more_rows: {count} more fields are not shown. They are the ones that agree.
conflict.not_in_conflict: This item is not in conflict any more.
conflict.notice: This item was changed here and somewhere else. Both versions are kept until you choose which one to keep. Until then, the server's version is the one in use.
conflict.passkey_note: This item has a passkey. A passkey cannot be copied, so you can only choose one of the two versions with the buttons below, and the other is dropped.
conflict.title: Resolve a conflict
conflict.trash.heading: Local trash
conflict.trash.intro: Deleted items stay on this device for 30 days, in encrypted form, so that a deletion can be undone. After that, and when you sign out, they are removed from this device.
conflict.trash.remove_body: The copy on this device is removed and cannot be brought back. The item is already deleted on the server.
conflict.trash.restored: {name} was restored. It is being synced back to the server.
conflict.trash.title: Local trash
